why_it_matters: Carpenters, game designers and skaters all need the length of the straight shortcut across a corner.

concepts.text: The long side c sits across from the right angle, and it is always the longest side
The two short sides squared add up to the long side squared: a² + b² = c²
Use it: legs 3 and 4 give 9 + 16 = 25, so the long side is 5

misconception: The long side of a right triangle is the two short sides added together, so c = a + b and legs 3 and 4 give 7

boss.name: Sultan Sum-Sum
boss.backstory: A camel with a sign reading 'C = A + B' who walks every shortcut the long way round and calls it efficiency.

taunt: Three plus four is seven. The shortcut is therefore seven. I have walked it.
The long way round is a form of shortcut.
I will not be squaring anything today.
heal: Excellent. Addition remains the most reliable of the operations.
Quite right. A shortcut is simply two walks.
hit: This is most irregular. The shortcut appears to be shorter than the walk.
I did not authorize a square.
lines.reformed: I have measured across. It was five, not seven. I would like to join you.

cliffhanger: I heard the same idea can tell you if a corner is really a right angle, just from the three sides. That can't be right… right?

quiz.question: In a right triangle, which side is the long side c, and how can you spot it?
quiz.answer: The side across from the right angle; it is the longest side.

quiz.question: If the short sides are a and b, what does c squared equal?
quiz.answer: a² + b² (the squares of the short sides added up).

quiz.question: A right triangle has short sides 3 and 4. How long is the long side?
quiz.answer: 5, because 9 + 16 = 25 and the square root of 25 is 5.
